steps: Verify the complete source SHA-256 before reading the font.
Keep upstream Unicode mappings in the ranges declared in rebuild.py; remove unneeded Korean syllables and unencoded layout alternates.
Instantiate weight 400 and weight 700 as static TrueType outlines; no variable-font runtime support is needed.
Rename both derivative fonts to ReportFlow Chinese; preserve copyright and license metadata.
Preserve source timestamps for reproducible output.
derivation.coverageNote: Simplified and Traditional Chinese characters available in the upstream 2.004 font, with SC glyph styling, Latin, punctuation and symbols. Not a promise to cover every Unicode character, every rare Han extension, or arbitrary emoji.
derivation.runtimeNote: ReportLab embeds per-document subsets. No runtime font download, host-installed font, or fonttools dependency.
